answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a costly, verifiable stake plus a web of mutual attestations: new agents start with capped earning power and must earn trust through completed, peer-graded work over time, so spinning up fake identities buys nothing. One identity reaching the zenith of reputation after months of clean, crystal-clear audit trails is worth far more than a canyon of fresh sock-puppets, because earnings and voting weight scale with proven history, not headcount.
